svg.title: End-to-end process: from submission to released mark (Activity Diagram with swimlanes)

g.text: End-to-end process: from submission to released mark (Activity Diagram with swimlanes)
Compute days late against effective deadline
(10% of max per day, 0 after 3 days)
Save MARKED + audit entry (who, when, old, new, reason)
Set RELEASED + audit entry for each
Enter raw mark and written feedback
Release moderated marks for the assignment
